headings.$description: Text on a standard surface. The main reading ramp. Headings only — heavier than body.

body.$description: Text on a standard surface. The main reading ramp. Default reading text.

label.$description: Text on a standard surface. The main reading ramp. Form and control labels.

caption.$description: Text on a standard surface. The main reading ramp. Small supporting text.

body-subtle.$description: Text on a standard surface. The main reading ramp. De-emphasised body; supporting copy.

disabled.$description: Text on a standard surface. The main reading ramp. Non-interactive state. Never rely on colour alone to signal this.

active.$description: Text on a standard surface. The main reading ramp. Currently selected or active item.

label-subtle.$description: Text on a standard surface. The main reading ramp. De-emphasised label.

caption-subtle.$description: Text on a standard surface. The main reading ramp. The dimmest readable text. Fails AA for small sizes on some surfaces — use for timestamps and metadata, never for content the user must read.

headings.$description: Text sitting on an inverted surface (colors/ui/surface/on-color/*). Do not use on the normal page background. Headings only — heavier than body.

body.$description: Text sitting on an inverted surface (colors/ui/surface/on-color/*). Do not use on the normal page background. Default reading text.

caption.$description: Text sitting on an inverted surface (colors/ui/surface/on-color/*). Do not use on the normal page background. Small supporting text.

placeholder.$description: Text sitting on an inverted surface (colors/ui/surface/on-color/*). Do not use on the normal page background. Empty-field placeholder.

primary.$description: Text sitting on the brand action fill. Held identical in Light and Dark because the action surface is. Default step.

primary-hover.$description: Text sitting on the brand action fill. Held identical in Light and Dark because the action surface is. Hover state.

primary.$description: Error-coloured text. Something failed or is invalid. Default step.

primary-hover.$description: Error-coloured text. Something failed or is invalid. Hover state.

on-color.$description: Error-coloured text. Something failed or is invalid. The variant for use on an inverted or coloured background.

on-color-hover.$description: Error-coloured text. Something failed or is invalid. Hover state of the on-color variant.

primary.$description: Success-coloured text. Something completed. Default step.

primary-hover.$description: Success-coloured text. Something completed. Hover state.

on-color.$description: Success-coloured text. Something completed. The variant for use on an inverted or coloured background.

on-color-hover.$description: Success-coloured text. Something completed. Hover state of the on-color variant.

primary.$description: Informational text. Neutral emphasis, not a success or a failure. Default step.

primary-hover.$description: Informational text. Neutral emphasis, not a success or a failure. Hover state.

on-color.$description: Informational text. Neutral emphasis, not a success or a failure. The variant for use on an inverted or coloured background.

on-color-hover.$description: Informational text. Neutral emphasis, not a success or a failure. Hover state of the on-color variant.

primary.$description: Warning-coloured text. Also the convention for "waiting on the user" — see agent-progress-indicator. Default step.

primary-hover.$description: Warning-coloured text. Also the convention for "waiting on the user" — see agent-progress-indicator. Hover state.

on-color.$description: Warning-coloured text. Also the convention for "waiting on the user" — see agent-progress-indicator. The variant for use on an inverted or coloured background.

on-color-hover.$description: Warning-coloured text. Also the convention for "waiting on the user" — see agent-progress-indicator. Hover state of the on-color variant.

canvas.$description: Structural page layer, non-interactive. Use for the fixed chrome a screen is built from. For anything with a hover state use colors/ui/surface/primary/* instead. The page itself; the bottom-most layer.

panel.$description: Structural page layer, non-interactive. Use for the fixed chrome a screen is built from. For anything with a hover state use colors/ui/surface/primary/* instead. A sidebar or docked region sitting on the canvas.

card.$description: Structural page layer, non-interactive. Use for the fixed chrome a screen is built from. For anything with a hover state use colors/ui/surface/primary/* instead. A discrete content block.

raised.$description: Structural page layer, non-interactive. Use for the fixed chrome a screen is built from. For anything with a hover state use colors/ui/surface/primary/* instead. Sits behind the canvas — app chrome under the content.

default.$description: Interactive component surface. This is the ramp with hover and disabled states — use it for cards, rows, chips and controls the user can act on. For static page structure use colors/ui/surface/base/*. Resting state.

default-hover.$description: Interactive component surface. This is the ramp with hover and disabled states — use it for cards, rows, chips and controls the user can act on. For static page structure use colors/ui/surface/base/*. Hover state of default.

secondary.$description: Interactive component surface. This is the ramp with hover and disabled states — use it for cards, rows, chips and controls the user can act on. For static page structure use colors/ui/surface/base/*. One step lifted from default.

secondary-hover.$description: Interactive component surface. This is the ramp with hover and disabled states — use it for cards, rows, chips and controls the user can act on. For static page structure use colors/ui/surface/base/*. Hover state of secondary.

tertiary.$description: Interactive component surface. This is the ramp with hover and disabled states — use it for cards, rows, chips and controls the user can act on. For static page structure use colors/ui/surface/base/*. Two steps lifted; the most prominent resting surface.

tertiary-hover.$description: Interactive component surface. This is the ramp with hover and disabled states — use it for cards, rows, chips and controls the user can act on. For static page structure use colors/ui/surface/base/*. Hover state of tertiary.

disabled.$description: Interactive component surface. This is the ramp with hover and disabled states — use it for cards, rows, chips and controls the user can act on. For static page structure use colors/ui/surface/base/*. Non-interactive state. Never rely on colour alone to signal this.

default.$description: Form control fill. Text fields, text areas, selects. Resting state.

secondary.$description: Form control fill. Text fields, text areas, selects. One step lifted from default.

error.$description: Status banner fill. Use behind notification and badge content. The plain step is the deeper fill; -subtle is the brighter one, not a transparent tint — this system has no tint tokens. Error state.

error-subtle.$description: Status banner fill. Use behind notification and badge content. The plain step is the deeper fill; -subtle is the brighter one, not a transparent tint — this system has no tint tokens.

success.$description: Status banner fill. Use behind notification and badge content. The plain step is the deeper fill; -subtle is the brighter one, not a transparent tint — this system has no tint tokens. Success state.

success-subtle.$description: Status banner fill. Use behind notification and badge content. The plain step is the deeper fill; -subtle is the brighter one, not a transparent tint — this system has no tint tokens.

information.$description: Status banner fill. Use behind notification and badge content. The plain step is the deeper fill; -subtle is the brighter one, not a transparent tint — this system has no tint tokens. Informational state.

information-subtle.$description: Status banner fill. Use behind notification and badge content. The plain step is the deeper fill; -subtle is the brighter one, not a transparent tint — this system has no tint tokens.

warning.$description: Status banner fill. Use behind notification and badge content. The plain step is the deeper fill; -subtle is the brighter one, not a transparent tint — this system has no tint tokens. Warning state.

warning-subtle.$description: Status banner fill. Use behind notification and badge content. The plain step is the deeper fill; -subtle is the brighter one, not a transparent tint — this system has no tint tokens.

primary.$description: Primary action fill (brand indigo). Reserved for the single most important action on a screen. Held identical in Light and Dark; pair with colors/ui/text/on-action/*. Default step.

primary-hover.$description: Primary action fill (brand indigo). Reserved for the single most important action on a screen. Held identical in Light and Dark; pair with colors/ui/text/on-action/*. Hover state.

default.$description: Inverted surface — a light block in Dark mode, a dark block in Light. Use when a panel must contrast against the page rather than sit in it. Pair with colors/ui/text/on-color/*. Resting state.

default-hover.$description: Inverted surface — a light block in Dark mode, a dark block in Light. Use when a panel must contrast against the page rather than sit in it. Pair with colors/ui/text/on-color/*. Hover state of default.

disabled.$description: Inverted surface — a light block in Dark mode, a dark block in Light. Use when a panel must contrast against the page rather than sit in it. Pair with colors/ui/text/on-color/*. Non-interactive state. Never rely on colour alone to signal this.

secondary.$description: Inverted surface — a light block in Dark mode, a dark block in Light. Use when a panel must contrast against the page rather than sit in it. Pair with colors/ui/text/on-color/*. One step lifted from default.

secondary-hover.$description: Inverted surface — a light block in Dark mode, a dark block in Light. Use when a panel must contrast against the page rather than sit in it. Pair with colors/ui/text/on-color/*. Hover state of secondary.

primary.$description: Border and outline colour. Default step.

primary-hover.$description: Border and outline colour. Hover state.

secondary.$description: Border and outline colour. One step lifted from default.

error.$description: Border and outline colour. Error state.

success.$description: Border and outline colour. Success state.

warning.$description: Border and outline colour. Warning state.

information.$description: Border and outline colour. Informational state.

action.$description: Border and outline colour. Border matching the brand action colour — selected and active states.

focus.$description: Border and outline colour. Keyboard focus ring. Held identical in Light and Dark so focus is always recognisable.

disabled.$description: Border and outline colour. Non-interactive state. Never rely on colour alone to signal this.

contrast.$description: Border and outline colour. Maximum-contrast border for high-visibility outlines.

on-color.$description: Border and outline colour. The variant for use on an inverted or coloured background.

on-color-hover.$description: Border and outline colour. Hover state of the on-color variant.

tertiary.$description: Border and outline colour. Two steps lifted; the most prominent resting surface.

tertiary-hover.$description: Border and outline colour. Hover state of tertiary.

primary.$description: Divider rule between sections or rows. Lighter weight than a border. Default step.

subtle.$description: Divider rule between sections or rows. Lighter weight than a border. De-emphasised step.

secondary.$description: Divider rule between sections or rows. Lighter weight than a border. One step lifted from default.

default.$description: Icon colour on a standard surface. Resting state.

disabled.$description: Icon colour on a standard surface. Non-interactive state. Never rely on colour alone to signal this.

subtle.$description: Icon colour on a standard surface. De-emphasised step.

default-hover.$description: Icon colour on a standard surface. Hover state of default.

on-color.$description: Icon colour on a standard surface. The variant for use on an inverted or coloured background.

on-color-hover.$description: Icon colour on a standard surface. Hover state of the on-color variant.

subtle-hover.$description: Icon colour on a standard surface. Hover state of subtle.

on-color.$description: Error-coloured icon. The variant for use on an inverted or coloured background.

on-color-hover.$description: Error-coloured icon. Hover state of the on-color variant.

on-color.$description: Success-coloured icon. The variant for use on an inverted or coloured background.

on-color-hover.$description: Success-coloured icon. Hover state of the on-color variant.

on-color.$description: Informational icon. The variant for use on an inverted or coloured background.

on-color-hover.$description: Informational icon. Hover state of the on-color variant.

on-color.$description: Warning-coloured icon. The variant for use on an inverted or coloured background.

on-color-hover.$description: Warning-coloured icon. Hover state of the on-color variant.

manager.$description: ROLE COLOUR — identifies WHICH AGENT a session belongs to. It never signals status; status is carried separately by colors/ui/text/{success,error,warning}/* and the secondary ramp for running. Categorical, so these steps are chosen for mutual distinguishability rather than for a lightness ramp. Manager — reads the task, picks the execution strategy, and decides between phases what runs next.

startup.$description: ROLE COLOUR — identifies WHICH AGENT a session belongs to. It never signals status; status is carried separately by colors/ui/text/{success,error,warning}/* and the secondary ramp for running. Categorical, so these steps are chosen for mutual distinguishability rather than for a lightness ramp. Startup — the original meta-agent that analyses a task and selects a strategy. Overlaps with manager; see the role legend.

planning.$description: ROLE COLOUR — identifies WHICH AGENT a session belongs to. It never signals status; status is carried separately by colors/ui/text/{success,error,warning}/* and the secondary ramp for running. Categorical, so these steps are chosen for mutual distinguishability rather than for a lightness ramp. Planning — writes the plan file before any code is touched.

research.$description: ROLE COLOUR — identifies WHICH AGENT a session belongs to. It never signals status; status is carried separately by colors/ui/text/{success,error,warning}/* and the secondary ramp for running. Categorical, so these steps are chosen for mutual distinguishability rather than for a lightness ramp. Research — web research for tasks the system has no prior knowledge of.

implementation.$description: ROLE COLOUR — identifies WHICH AGENT a session belongs to. It never signals status; status is carried separately by colors/ui/text/{success,error,warning}/* and the secondary ramp for running. Categorical, so these steps are chosen for mutual distinguishability rather than for a lightness ramp. Implementation — the agent that actually writes code and does the milestone work.

coordinator.$description: ROLE COLOUR — identifies WHICH AGENT a session belongs to. It never signals status; status is carried separately by colors/ui/text/{success,error,warning}/* and the secondary ramp for running. Categorical, so these steps are chosen for mutual distinguishability rather than for a lightness ramp. Coordinator — detects a stalled implementation and selects which reviewers to bring in.

reviewer.$description: ROLE COLOUR — identifies WHICH AGENT a session belongs to. It never signals status; status is carried separately by colors/ui/text/{success,error,warning}/* and the secondary ramp for running. Categorical, so these steps are chosen for mutual distinguishability rather than for a lightness ramp. Reviewer — a specialist checking one dimension (security, test integrity). Several run in parallel.

supervisor.$description: ROLE COLOUR — identifies WHICH AGENT a session belongs to. It never signals status; status is carried separately by colors/ui/text/{success,error,warning}/* and the secondary ramp for running. Categorical, so these steps are chosen for mutual distinguishability rather than for a lightness ramp. Supervisor — merges review fixes, verifies integrity, decides whether to iterate again.

primary.$description: Syntax highlighting tier. primary is the brightest, subtle the dimmest. Default step.

tertiary.$description: Syntax highlighting tier. primary is the brightest, subtle the dimmest. Two steps lifted; the most prominent resting surface.

secondary.$description: Syntax highlighting tier. primary is the brightest, subtle the dimmest. One step lifted from default.

subtle.$description: Syntax highlighting tier. primary is the brightest, subtle the dimmest. De-emphasised step.

on-color.$description: Syntax highlighting tier. primary is the brightest, subtle the dimmest. De-emphasised step.

plain.$description: Identifiers and plain code. Aliases editor/syntax/primary.

keyword.$description: Keywords, control flow, operators. Dark → alias/colors/syntax/dracula/pink, Light → alias/colors/syntax/alucard/pink.

function.$description: Function and method names. Dark → alias/colors/syntax/dracula/green, Light → alias/colors/syntax/alucard/green.

string.$description: Strings and char literals. Dark → alias/colors/syntax/dracula/yellow, Light → alias/colors/syntax/alucard/yellow.

number.$description: Numbers, booleans, constants. Dark → alias/colors/syntax/dracula/purple, Light → alias/colors/syntax/alucard/purple.

type.$description: Types, classes, structs. Dark → alias/colors/syntax/dracula/cyan, Light → alias/colors/syntax/alucard/cyan.

parameter.$description: Parameters and arguments. Dark → alias/colors/syntax/dracula/orange, Light → alias/colors/syntax/alucard/orange.

error.$description: Errors and invalid tokens. Dark → alias/colors/syntax/dracula/red, Light → alias/colors/syntax/alucard/red.

comment.$description: Comments and doc blocks. Dark → alias/colors/syntax/dracula/comment, Light → alias/colors/syntax/alucard/comment.

disabled.$description: Folded or unreachable code. Aliases editor/syntax/subtle.

current-line.$description: The active line band. Dark → alias/colors/syntax/dracula/current-line, Light → alias/colors/syntax/alucard/current-line. Note the official spec sets Current Line equal to Comment in both palettes, so these are dark values; if you want a light band behind the caret row in Light mode, editor/surface/select is the warm alternative.

selection.$description: Selected text band. Dark → alias/colors/syntax/dracula/selection, Light → alias/colors/syntax/alucard/selection. Alucard's selection is a cool lavender-grey (#CFCFDE) that reads cold against this product's #E6E2DB editor ground; editor/surface/select (#DBD6CC) is the warm equivalent and is what the syntax accents were levelled against.
